plugins.name: reflection-cc
plugins.description: Re-prompts Claude Code when it stops prematurely — catches PERMISSION-SEEKING, STOPPED-WITH-TODOS, and FALSE-COMPLETE failure modes (78% of real agent stops are premature), and injects targeted recovery instructions via the Stop hook.

plugins.name: task-gh-guard
plugins.description: Blocks the end of a turn while GitHub CI for a commit this session pushed is red or still running.

plugins.name: turn-check
plugins.description: When the agent stops, a cheap model audits the whole conversation against ~/.agents/AGENTS.md. Rule violations are fed back to the agent on your next message.
